events.name: Bash
events.head: Show current state of the export scripts, logs and pass.py usage
events.input: $ git diff -- cloud/.export-centre.sh | head -60; echo ---EC; sed -n 55,80p cloud/.export-centre.sh; echo ---ES; sed -n 58,78p app/scripts/export-static.sh; echo ---LOG; grep -n "publish held\|PUBLISH HELD\|08:15" workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md | tail -8; grep -n -i "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -5; echo ---; git status -sb | head -3; git log origin/main --oneline -1; python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py --help 2>&1 | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check remote, how the centre export script is produced, and unpushed commits
events.input: $ git remote -v; grep -rn "export-centre" --include=*.sh --include=*.py --include=*.mjs --include=*.md --include=*.json . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | grep -v "tasks/activity\|tasks.json\|ledger\|decisions/" | head -15; echo ---; git log --oneline -4 -- cloud/.export-centre.sh; git reflog show origin/main --date=iso | head -5; echo; ls .github/workflows 2>/dev/null; git log origin/main..main --oneline | cat; echo ---; diff <(sed 's#^APP=.*##' cloud/.export-centre.sh) <(sed 's#^APP=.*##' app/scripts/export-static.sh) | head -40; grep -n "^APP=" app/scripts/export-static.sh

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how the centre build produces and uses the export script
events.input: $ grep -n "export-centre\|PUBLISH_VERBATIM\|if false" cloud/scripts/*.sh cloud/*.sh app/scripts/*.sh workshop-plan/ops/*.py 2>/dev/null | head -20; sed -n 12,34p cloud/scripts/build.sh; git log -3 --format='%h %ad %s' --date=iso -- cloud/.export-centre.sh | cat; stat -f '%Sm' cloud/.export-centre.sh
